problem: The control plane lacks a deterministic live repository snapshot that joins queue, claims, runs, returns and readiness; workers currently reconstruct state through repeated ad hoc reads and Control Room fixture semantics do not prove live wiring.
acceptance: one invocation deterministically emits a joined snapshot from current repository state without mutating queue or authority
snapshot classifies ready claimed started returned stale and blocked work and records source refs and source heads
repeated invocation on the same source head is byte-stable
concurrent repository change is detected as drift rather than silently mixing epochs
Control Room and allocator can consume the snapshot as candidate input without changing authority
title: Live swarm snapshot compiler
mission: Implement a read-only executable compiler that joins the live universal queue, claims, runs, returns and dependency/readiness evidence into one deterministic source-pinned snapshot. Refuse mixed-epoch truth by surfacing repository drift, preserve provenance for every classification, and leave the output as candidate control-plane evidence only.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Fresh workers currently have to reconstruct live allocation state from repeated queue/claim/run/return reads; one source-pinned snapshot removes that courier/scheduler-style reconstruction burden.

unblock_value.reason: The throughput critic found that Control Room fixture semantics do not prove a full live repository snapshot or allocator wiring, blocking trustworthy high-parallelism control-plane projection.

regression_prevention.reason: Source-head pinning and explicit drift detection prevent a worker from silently classifying one apparent state from queue/claims/runs/returns read across different repository epochs.

fail_if: one snapshot silently combines inputs observed from different source heads without a drift marker
classification depends on directory listing order or non-deterministic timestamps
the compiler mutates queue, claim, run, return, Current, Human Accepted or Served authority
a returned/claimed/stale/blocked classification lacks inspectable source evidence
falsification.pass_if: The same pinned repository source produces byte-stable joined classification, a moving source is detected as drift rather than fused as truth, every state has provenance, and downstream Control Room/allocator readers can consume the candidate snapshot without authority mutation.
